description: Light and shadow probes for the 3D capture bench (plan ai-agent/tasks/rgce-3d-lighting-shadows-tasks.md, T1). Points are in full-resolution pixels of the 1280x720 captures; the tool averages a 9x9 square around each. Classes: lit, shadow, away (faces away from the sun and is NOT shadowed by the original), away-shadowed (faces away and is shadowed by the original; reported, not judged until S2b). Chosen on original-s1a (nopost) against rgce-t1; each point sits on a patch that is uniform in both pictures (25x25 mean within a few levels of the 9x9 mean) and at least 8 px from any shadow edge, object edge or lane marking.
